summary: Frontend E2E testing of the 'Freund herausfordern' async quiz duel UI (Part 2, built on already-verified backend). All flows tested via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667): Home screen CTA placement, duel creation, full 5-question play-through, results view (placeholder + real opponent score), duel-join modal for a second signed-up user, creator re-open showing both scores, invalid duel code error state, EN/DE/ES localization, and /practice regression. Everything works as specified with NO bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx: duel-cta correctly placed directly below practice-cta, duel-join link below that -- matches spec exactly.

app/duel/[id].tsx: mirrors practice.tsx's quiz UI/UX faithfully (options, check/continue, progress bar, tier tag), posts to /duels/{id}/complete (verified via UI flow -- no XP awarded, confirmed 0 XP before and after via /api/auth/me).

hasPlayed logic (myResult truthy) correctly renders results view immediately on GET without re-fetch tricks; otherRestult null renders '—' placeholder + Share button; once otherResult present, Share button correctly disappears (verified for both creator-reopen and opponent's own results view).

duel-join modal correctly validates empty code (shows joinPlaceholder as error) and navigates to /duel/{code} for any non-empty code; invalid/garbage code ('zzzzzzzz') correctly triggers 404 -> duel-back-error state with working back button to Learn screen, no crash/red-screen.

Translations complete and correct across en/de/es for all duel.* keys (homeTitle, homeSub, joinLink, joinTitle, joinSub, joinPlaceholder, joinSubmit, you, friend, resultsTitle, waiting, share, shareMessage, notFound) -- verified visually in DE and ES.
/practice flow (practice-cta, practice-option-0, practice-action-button) confirmed completely unaffected -- regression pass.

Minor observation (not a bug): EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not set in frontend/.env, only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present; existing test file test_iteration_30_duels.py already has a fallback for this so no action needed, but noting for consistency with system prompt's expected env var name.

success_rate.backend: N/A - not retested, prior iteration 13/13 passed and unaffected by this change

seed_data_creation: Created one duel as demo@tradequest.app (duel_id c25d301d, fully played to completion by creator + one fresh signup user), plus a fresh test user via UI signup flow (TEST_duelUI_*@example.com) to act as the opponent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duel frontend feature (Part 2) is fully verified end-to-end: CTA placement, duel creation & navigation, full quiz play-through with correct completion endpoint (not practice), no XP/reward, results view with placeholder vs real opponent score transitions correctly in both directions (creator-first and opponent-first), Share button visibility logic correct, join-by-code flow works for a second real signed-up user, invalid code shows proper error state with working back navigation, and all 3 locales (EN/DE/ES) render translated duel UI correctly. /practice regression confirmed unaffected. No bugs found -- feature is ready.
